ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As illustrated, point C is the midpoint of segment AB, point D is a point on segment BC, and point E is the midpoint of segment CD. Given $AB=20$ and $BD=4$, find the length of segment CD.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Because $AB=20$ and $BD=4$,\\
it follows that $AD=AB-BD=20-4=16$,\\
since point C is the midpoint of line segment AB,\\
it follows that $AC=BC=10$,\\
therefore $CD=AD-AC=16-10=\boxed{6};$
